title: Ender Teleport
description: Don't Waste time cause moving there...
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d0178f753f7d3dd00828a25e4cf6f29b4bb7814.png)

**Turn an Ender Pearl in your pocket into a personal teleporter.** Hold a Clock, Lodestone Compass, or Recovery Compass and crouch for 2 seconds — no commands, no crafting, no special items.

> A lightweight **data pack** for **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11**.

## ✨ What it does
While you are **carrying an Ender Pearl** (it is *not* used up), hold one of these everyday items and **hold Sneak/Crouch (Shift) for 2 seconds** to teleport:

| Hold this item | You teleport to… |
| --- | --- |
| 🕐 **Clock** | Your **respawn point** (your bed or respawn anchor) |
| 🧭 **Lodestone Compass** | The **lodestone** it is linked to |
| 🔮 **Recovery Compass** | The spot where you **last died** |

A countdown appears on your screen while you charge, so you always know it's working.

## 🎒 What you need
1. An **Ender Pearl** anywhere in your inventory — it stays, it's just the "key".
2. One of the three items above, held in your **main hand**.
3. That's it. These are normal vanilla items; no crafting or commands required.

For the Lodestone Compass, link a normal compass to a lodestone the usual way: right-click a placed lodestone block while holding a compass.

## 🎮 How to use (step by step)
1. Make sure you have an **Ender Pearl** in your inventory.
2. Hold the **Clock**, **Lodestone Compass**, or **Recovery Compass** in your hand.
3. **Hold the Sneak key (Shift by default) for 2 seconds.**
4. Watch the countdown — when it finishes, *poof*, you're there!

💡 **Tips**
- Release Sneak and press it again to teleport a second time.
- Releasing Sneak (or switching items) before the countdown ends cancels it.
- The Recovery Compass won't drop you into lava — if lava is above your death spot, it places you safely on top.

## 📦 How to install a data pack (for beginners)
Data packs go *inside a single world*, not in a mods folder.
1. **Download** this pack.
2. On the world you want, click **Edit → Open World Folder** (or open `.minecraft/saves/<your world>`).
3. Open the **`datapacks`** folder.
4. **Drop the pack inside** (the `.zip` or the `ender_teleport` folder — either works).
5. Back in game, run **`/reload`**, or leave and re-enter the world.

When it loads you'll see a purple message in chat. ✅
> **Servers:** put the pack in the server world's `datapacks` folder, then run `/reload`.

## 🔍 Handy command
- `/function ender_teleport:check_spawn` — shows your detected respawn point (coordinates + dimension).

## ❓ FAQ
**Does it use up my Ender Pearl?** No — it only needs to be in your inventory.

**Do I need special crafted items?** No — a normal Clock, Recovery Compass, and lodestone-linked Compass all work.

**Which dimensions work?** The Overworld, the Nether, and the End.

**Nothing happens when I sneak.** Check that you (1) have an Ender Pearl, (2) hold the item in your **main hand**, and (3) keep Sneak held for the full 2 seconds.
